Name: Donut's Victor Seasonal Anime Potraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
Simply a portrait of Victor which was made specifically with Ohodavi's Anime style in mind, hopefully i managed to capture this style and make a character who still looks like victor!

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Victor's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Victors folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Portraits -> Victor, replacing the portraits originally from there.
